items.title: 7.5 Computing's Impact on Individuals and Society (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of computing's impact (PDF 186).

blocks.text: Computing systems ne hamare rehne, kaam karne aur aapas mein baat cheet (communicate) karne ka tareeqa bilkul badal (revolutionize) diya hai aur muashre mein gehri tabdeeliyan layi hain. Internet, smartphones aur artificial intelligence (AI, machine ki banawati zehanat) jaisi technologies ke aam istemal ke musbat (positive) aur manfi (negative) dono asar hue hain.

blocks.prompt: Computing ka ek musbat aur ek manfi asar bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Musbat: maloomat aur taleem tak aasan rasai (jaise Coursera, edX). Manfi: ghalat maloomat aur fake news ka tezi se phailna (jaise COVID-19 ke dauran).

items: Internet, smartphones aur AI ne zindagi, kaam aur baat cheet badal di; asar musbat bhi, manfi bhi.
